purpose: Search only for the minimum traceable evidence needed to define the historic garden-residence compound subset, bind named members to accepted OSM ways, close same-member Hero views, and authorize a legal Hero-to-Identity lineage.

historicSubjectBoundary.bindingIntent: Determine whether each named member can be assigned to one accepted OSM way with traceable evidence; this contract does not authorize rebinding, member replacement, footprint edits, or stable-ID expansion.

excludedNamespaceEvidence.subject: number-67-elevator-site-plan
excludedNamespaceEvidence.reason: The plan concerns the wider 329-lane address namespace and does not label the historic garden-residence members or bind them to accepted OSM ways.

excludedNamespaceEvidence.subject: generic-329-lane-address
excludedNamespaceEvidence.reason: An address containing 329 Lane does not prove membership in the current historic compound subset.

acceptanceMatrix.passWhen: Record post URL, author/display name, collection time, publication time if visible, post text, and the exact image or video frame used.
Evidence distinguishes the historic garden-residence subset from the wider 329-lane address namespace.
A named member among 17, 36, 38, 40 or 42 is assigned to exactly one accepted OSM way using an orientable plan or independently cross-checked fixed anchors.
The same bound member has canonical, side or depth, entrance or identity detail, rear or roof-back where modeled, camera direction and scale evidence.
Every member proposed for the compound Hero passes member binding and view closure, and the compound boundary and circulation remain explicit.
A new pure-building Hero records the accepted Massing SHA, source way, member set, placement, collision semantics and evidence paths before MCP2.
Identity is derived only from the frozen SHA of a new same-subject Hero after that Hero passes MCP2.

publicAndUserPhotoBoundary.publicMedia: Public posts are supplemental traceable evidence and must never be labeled as user-taken photographs.
publicAndUserPhotoBoundary.userMedia: Any later user-supplied original must retain its own source path and metadata and remain distinct from public material.
publicAndUserPhotoBoundary.noSubstitution: A public image, thumbnail, generated image, contact sheet, or runtime screenshot cannot fill a user-photo slot.

dynamicEvidenceStorage.futureMediaAndEvidence: If main-window browsing later retains media or per-asset evidence, create a new immutable snapshot using scripts/archive_dynamic_evidence.sh; never overwrite an older snapshot.
dynamicEvidenceStorage.repositoryBoundary: The repository may keep only compatibility working copies and small indexes required by existing scripts, with the external snapshot ID, relative path and SHA recorded.
dynamicEvidenceStorage.wikiBoundary: Downloaded social media, images, videos, audio, screenshots, runtime metrics, evidence JSON and manifests for this asset must not enter any LLM Wiki, including Threejs-3d-research or TowerOld.

stopImmediatelyOn: any uncertainty that an interaction changes account state
prohibited: parallel agents, parallel tabs, or bulk automation
likes, saves, follows, comments, messages, or other social actions
behavior simulation, detection evasion, challenge bypass, or retry loops

postSearchDisposition.reasonableExhaustion: Main window attempted all four query groups within the conservative limits, logged every opened result and rejection reason, and found no admissible evidence combination that closes the acceptance matrix.
postSearchDisposition.beforeExhaustion: Retain the accepted four-member Massing runtime unchanged. Do not disable the building or alter assets, registry, runtime, shared files, Recovery/Hold, or evidence archives.
postSearchDisposition.afterExhaustion: Main window may propose runtime disable for xinhua-villas-329 only. Disable is not automatic and must be accompanied by a retained-file audit.
postSearchDisposition.permanentRetention: All GLB, Blend, generators, evidence, screenshots, tests, public-source records, Recovery/Hold files and rejected candidates remain permanently preserved.

prohibitedHere: Blender, model, generator, registry or runtime change
shared Fast manifest, status or roster change
tree, decoration, full-map or other-building work
